European engineering bar is sold as base + scrap surcharge + alloy surcharge. Surcharges were found (Frankstahl Feb 2026, Ovako Jan 2026); the base was not. FLOORS in notes = undated 24metal C45 (3.173) + alloy surcharge; they exclude the alloy-quality base extra and are NOT prices.

Book checks (current PLN/kg). CONFIDENT INCONSISTENT: mat-steel4140 5.98 v mat-steel-42crmo4 7.96 - same grade (4140 = 42CrMo4), 33% apart; mat-steel4340 7.17 is BELOW 42CrMo4 7.96 although Ni-Cr-Mo surcharges run ~EUR 174/t (0.76 PLN/kg) above 42CrMo4 (34CrNiMo6 314 v 42CrMo4 140) - 4340 should sit at about the 34CrNiMo6 figure 8.95; mat-steel4130 / 25CrMo4 7.91 above 4140 5.98 is inverted (less Cr/C). mat-steel-20mncr5 / 16mncr5 / 41cr4 all 7.32 - copies, though 41Cr4 and 16MnCr5 surcharges are only ~EUR 40/t. Level of the alloy-bar group (7.3-9.0) v floor 3.3-4.5: likely high but NOT confident (base unknown).
